summary: RETEST of the 3 fixes from iteration_8 for HorizonQuest Skill Studio (Docs track). ALL THREE FIXES VERIFIED. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_skillstudio.py (updated test_201/202/310/420/910 to reflect the new sticky best-attempt response + m3 completability). Frontend: color popover now renders 128px wide with three real 31px columns and all 6 swatches visible in 2 rows x 3 cols (previously 36px stacked); clicking blue sets b1 to rgb(37,99,235), red sets b3 to rgb(220,38,38); docs-m4 both tasks tick. docs-m3 UI flow (Times New Roman on all, 12pt on b2+b3, 24pt on b1) ticks 3/3 and submit dialog shows grade A / 100% / 3/3. Hub /studio/docs shows all 12 cards with grade A + green mastery check including docs-m2 (previously stale F after partial resubmit) and docs-m3 (previously impossible).
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: DocEditorCore.jsx <option> children currently include the injected <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapper from the preview instrumentation, which generates a React hydration warning ('span cannot be a child of option'). This appears to be preview-tooling injection rather than product code and does not affect functionality. If it is easy to opt this file out of source-map instrumentation, worth doing.

Non-blocking: response 'mastery' now correctly returns sticky best-attempt (matches persisted state) — the submit dialog message on a lower resubmit now reads 'Graded A · +0 Horizon Points' which is correct.
Non-blocking a11y: color/symbol/table popovers still don't close on Escape (only on outside click). Minor.
Optional: consider adding a Pydantic schema for the submitted doc shape in POST /api/studio/{track}/{mission}/submit for defense-in-depth.
